desc: Ideation: delta formula Ans += (v−old)·L_ex[c]·R_ex[c], transpose-to-W≤447 trick; naive cone/matrix approaches too slow; walk structure is the crux.

Derivation: refuted O(1)/O(min(H,W)) walk-based incremental repair (delta propagates through full cone, no amortized bound); established key fact that within a block of B queries all dirty cells lie in a B×B bounding box (walk moves ≤ B steps per block).
Implement sqrt-over-queries algorithm with per-row stored vectors and numpy row DP (cumsum→%→multiply→%), with transpose direction remap and block rebuild every 450 queries.
Validate vs samples 1 & 2 and random small grids vs brute force (zeros, revisits, 2×2, transpose path H<W); both samples match exactly; dead code removed.

Adversarial performance check: added pure-Python DP path for W ≤ 24, adaptive rebuild when dirty suffix > max(4B, H/4), pre-decoded queries; identified residual risk for 447×447 with top_dirty=1 every query.

Final verification: re-run both samples, stress-test small-W path vs brute force on random grids/walks, benchmark 447×447 worst case; apply numpy buffer micro-optimizations (out= params) if beneficial.
Finalize STDIN→STDOUT program in required code delimiters; final sample check.
